The install itself succeeded, but the folder migration did not finish. The blocker is a duplicate file already present in both uppercase and lowercase bundle-manifest folders, so we need a safe merge, not a blind rename.

The patch install succeeded.

The problem is only the folder migration:

Target file already exists, refusing overwrite:
E:\kanda_reasoner\workbench\bundle_manifest\BUNDLE_MANIFEST_ai_bridge_live_source_grounding_fix.txt

So you now probably have both folders:

E:\kanda_reasoner\workbench\BUNDLE_MANIFEST
E:\kanda_reasoner\workbench\bundle_manifest

Do not freeze yet. Run this safe merge script.

$PROJECT_ROOT = "E:\kanda_reasoner"
$OLD_DIR = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "workbench\BUNDLE_MANIFEST"
$NEW_DIR = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "workbench\bundle_manifest"

Set-Location $PROJECT_ROOT

if (!(Test-Path $NEW_DIR)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $NEW_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Host "Created: $NEW_DIR"
}

if (!(Test-Path $OLD_DIR)) {
    Write-Host "Old uppercase folder does not exist. Nothing to migrate."
}
else {
    $oldFiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $OLD_DIR -File -Force
    $conflicts = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $oldFiles) {
        $targetPath = Join-Path $NEW_DIR $file.Name

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            $oldHash = Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Algorithm SHA256
            $newHash = Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $targetPath -Algorithm SHA256

            if ($oldHash.Hash -eq $newHash.Hash) {
                Remove-Item -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Force
                Write-Host "Removed duplicate identical file from old folder: $($file.Name)"
            }
            else {
                $conflicts.Add($file.Name)
                Write-Host "Conflict with different content: $($file.Name)"
            }
        }
        else {
            Move-Item -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath
            Write-Host "Moved $($file.Name) to lowercase bundle_manifest"
        }
    }

    if ($conflicts.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Host "MIGRATION STOPPED DUE TO DIFFERENT-CONTENT CONFLICTS"
        Write-Host "Review these files manually:"
        foreach ($name in $conflicts) {
            Write-Host $name
        }
        throw "Bundle manifest migration has unresolved conflicts."
    }

    $remaining = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $OLD_DIR -Force

    if ($remaining.Count -eq 0) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $OLD_DIR -Force
        Write-Host "Removed empty uppercase folder: $OLD_DIR"
    }
    else {
        Write-Host "Old uppercase folder still has remaining items:"
        $remaining | Select-Object FullName
        throw "Old uppercase folder is not empty."
    }
}

Write-Host "Migration completed."
Write-Host "Canonical folder:"
Write-Host $NEW_DIR

function Restore-ReasonerContextBundleRenamePatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.deleted_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored deleted file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $deletedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }
        else {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    foreach ($relativePath in $DELETE_RELATIVE_PATHS) {
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            $deletedFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @($deletedFiles)
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($relativePath in $DELETE_RELATIVE_PATHS) {
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Deleted legacy implementation file: $relativePath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ReasonerContextBundleRenamePatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

function Restore-ArchitectureWarningCleanupPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"

what is best intuitive name for this folder ?

Stopped thinking

what is best intuitive name for this folder kanda_reasoner_app/project_reasoner_v10 ?

Best intuitive name:

kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine

Why this is better than project_reasoner_v10:

project_reasoner_v10

sounds like an old versioned implementation folder. It exposes history instead of meaning.

reasoner_engine

sounds like the active internal reasoning/analysis engine of the app. It is short, intuitive, stable, and future-proof.

My recommendation:

kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10
        -> kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine

Other possible names:

analysis_engine

Good, but a little generic.

project_analyzer

Good if the folder mainly analyzes projects, but less broad than the full reasoner.

reasoning_engine

Good, but slightly more abstract.

developer_reasoner

Too narrow if Kanda Reasoner later analyzes other kinds of projects.

Final vote:

reasoner_engine

Keep compatibility temporarily:

kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10

should remain as a legacy shim only during migration, just like we did with:

project_context_bundle -> reasoner_context_bundle


implement kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine

Implemented as the safe first rename gate.

This creates:

kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine

as the canonical package facade, while keeping:

kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10

as the physical implementation for now.

Gate 1 now:
reasoner_engine = canonical facade

Later gates:
move project_reasoner_v10 internals into reasoner_engine in smaller owner-box batches

function Restore-ReasonerEngineCompatibilityRepair {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }
            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }
        else {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ReasonerEngineCompatibilityRepair -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

$MANIFEST_PATH = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR "install_manifest.json"

function Restore-LegacyAskAiProjectReasonerShim {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }
            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!(Test-Path $targetPath)) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-LegacyAskAiProjectReasonerShim -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

    "__init__.py",

    "run_project_reasoner_v10.py"
)

function Restore-ReasonerEngineCompleteMigrationPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }
            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.deleted_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }
            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored deleted file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $deletedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    if (Test-Path $LEGACY_DIR) {
        $legacyFiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LEGACY_DIR -File -Recurse -Force |
            Where-Object {
                $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*" -and
                !($LEGACY_KEEP_FILES -contains $_.Name)
            }

        foreach ($file in $legacyFiles) {
            $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($PROJECT_ROOT.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
            $deletedFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @($deletedFiles)
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
        preserved_top_level_legacy_package = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($relativePath in $deletedFiles) {
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Deleted old project_reasoner_v10 implementation file: $relativePath"
        }
    }

    if (Test-Path $LEGACY_DIR) {
        $legacyDirs = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LEGACY_DIR -Directory -Recurse -Force |
            Sort-Object FullName -Descending

        foreach ($dir in $legacyDirs) {
            $children = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir.FullName -Force
            if ($children.Count -eq 0) {
                Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dir.FullName -Force
                Write-Host "Removed empty legacy directory: $($dir.FullName)"
            }
        }
    }

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ReasonerEngineCompleteMigrationPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

Complete install PowerShell

Save ZIP here:

E:\kanda_reasoner_reasoner_engine_ai_bridge_canonical_migration.zip

Run outside PyCharm:

$PROJECT_ROOT = "E:\kanda_reasoner"
$PATCH_NAME = "kanda_reasoner_reasoner_engine_ai_bridge_canonical_migration"
$ZIP_PATH = "E:\kanda_reasoner_reasoner_engine_ai_bridge_canonical_migration.zip"
$TEMP_DIR = Join-Path $env:TEMP $PATCH_NAME

$DRIVE_ROOT = [System.IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($PROJECT_ROOT)
$BACKUP_ROOT = Join-Path $DRIVE_ROOT "_kanda_patch_backups"
$STAMP = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$BACKUP_DIR = Join-Path $BACKUP_ROOT "${PATCH_NAME}_$STAMP"
$MANIFEST_PATH = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR "install_manifest.json"

function Restore-ReasonerEngineAiBridgeMigrationPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }
            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
        preserved_top_level_legacy_package = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        preserved_legacy_engine_package = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ReasonerEngineAiBridgeMigrationPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

function Restore-ReasonerEngineHelpIndexMigrationPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }
            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
        preserved_top_level_legacy_package = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        preserved_legacy_engine_package = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ReasonerEngineHelpIndexMigrationPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
        preserved_top_level_legacy_package = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        preserved_legacy_engine_package = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ReasonerEngineProjectProfileMigrationPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

$PROJECT_ROOT = "E:\kanda_reasoner"
$PATCH_NAME = "kanda_reasoner_reasoner_engine_index_loader_canonical_migration"
$ZIP_PATH = "E:\kanda_reasoner_reasoner_engine_index_loader_canonical_migration.zip"
$TEMP_DIR = Join-Path $env:TEMP $PATCH_NAME

$DRIVE_ROOT = [System.IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($PROJECT_ROOT)
$BACKUP_ROOT = Join-Path $DRIVE_ROOT "_kanda_patch_backups"
$STAMP = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$BACKUP_DIR = Join-Path $BACKUP_ROOT "${PATCH_NAME}_$STAMP"
$MANIFEST_PATH = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR "install_manifest.json"

$LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
$CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine"

$DYNAMIC_COPY_PAIRS = @(
    @("index_loader.py", "index_loader.py"),
    @("index_loader_help.json", "index_loader_help.json"),
    @("index_loader_validate_manifests.py", "index_loader_validate_manifests.py"),
    @("index_loader_refactor_notes.md", "index_loader_refactor_notes.md")
)

function Backup-FileIfPresent {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [string]$RelativePath,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath
    $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

    if ($existsBefore) {
        $OverwrittenFiles.Add($RelativePath)
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $RelativePath
        $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
    }

    if (!$existsBefore) {
        $NewlyCreatedFiles.Add($RelativePath)
    }
}

function Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile {
    param(
        [string]$SourcePath,
        [string]$TargetPath
    )

    $targetParent = Split-Path $TargetPath -Parent

    if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
    }

    Copy-Item -Path $SourcePath -Destination $TargetPath -Force

    $extension = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($TargetPath).ToLowerInvariant()

    if ($extension -in @(".py", ".json", ".md", ".txt")) {
        $text = Get-Content -Path $TargetPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8

        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("ask_ai_project_reasoner.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app/project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("project_reasoner_v10/index_loader", "reasoner_engine/index_loader")
        $text = $text.Replace("project_reasoner_v10\index_loader", "reasoner_engine\index_loader")

        Set-Content -Path $TargetPath -Value $text -Encoding UTF8
    }
}

function Restore-ReasonerEngineIndexLoaderMigrationPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }
            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR)) {
        throw "Legacy engine folder not found: $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR)) {
        throw "Canonical engine folder not found: $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $dynamicCopiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($pair in $DYNAMIC_COPY_PAIRS) {
        $sourceRelative = [string]$pair[0]
        $targetRelative = [string]$pair[1]
        $sourcePath = Join-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR $sourceRelative
        $targetPath = Join-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR $targetRelative
        $targetProjectRelative = "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine\$targetRelative"

        if (Test-Path $sourcePath) {
            Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $targetProjectRelative -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
            Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile -SourcePath $sourcePath -TargetPath $targetPath
            $dynamicCopiedFiles.Add($targetProjectRelative)
            Write-Host "Copied canonical index_loader file: $targetProjectRelative"
        }
    }

    $legacyHelpDir = Join-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR "index_loader_help"
    $canonicalHelpDir = Join-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR "index_loader_help"

    if (!(Test-Path $legacyHelpDir)) {
        throw "Legacy index_loader_help folder not found: $legacyHelpDir"
    }

    $legacyHelpFiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $legacyHelpDir -File -Recurse -Force |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*"
        }

    foreach ($sourceFile in $legacyHelpFiles) {
        $relativeInsideHelp = $sourceFile.FullName.Substring($legacyHelpDir.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $canonicalHelpDir $relativeInsideHelp
        $targetProjectRelative = Join-Path "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine\index_loader_help" $relativeInsideHelp

        Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $targetProjectRelative -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
        Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile -SourcePath $sourceFile.FullName -TargetPath $targetPath
        $dynamicCopiedFiles.Add($targetProjectRelative)
        Write-Host "Copied canonical index_loader helper: $targetProjectRelative"
    }

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        dynamic_copied_files = @($dynamicCopiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
        preserved_top_level_legacy_package = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        preserved_legacy_engine_package = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ReasonerEngineIndexLoaderMigrationPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

Write-Host $TARGET_FILE
Write-Host "Size before:"
Write-Host $bytesBefore.Length

$hasBomBefore = $false
if ($bytesBefore.Length -ge 3) {
    $hasBomBefore = (
        $bytesBefore[0] -eq 0xEF -and
        $bytesBefore[1] -eq 0xBB -and
        $bytesBefore[2] -eq 0xBF
    )
}

Write-Host "UTF-8 BOM before:"
Write-Host $hasBomBefore

$text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($TARGET_FILE)
$utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TARGET_FILE, $text, $utf8NoBom)

$bytesAfter = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($TARGET_FILE)
$hasBomAfter = $false
if ($bytesAfter.Length -ge 3) {
    $hasBomAfter = (
        $bytesAfter[0] -eq 0xEF -and
        $bytesAfter[1] -eq 0xBB -and
        $bytesAfter[2] -eq 0xBF
    )
}

Write-Host "Size after:"
Write-Host $bytesAfter.Length
Write-Host "UTF-8 BOM after:"
Write-Host $hasBomAfter
Write-Host "REPAIR COMPLETED"

Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
Clear-Host

function Backup-FileIfPresent {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [string]$RelativePath,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath
    $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

    if ($existsBefore) {
        $OverwrittenFiles.Add($RelativePath)
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $RelativePath
        $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
    }

    if (!$existsBefore) {
        $NewlyCreatedFiles.Add($RelativePath)
    }
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile {
    param(
        [string]$SourcePath,
        [string]$TargetPath
    )

    $targetParent = Split-Path $TargetPath -Parent

    if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
    }

    Copy-Item -Path $SourcePath -Destination $TargetPath -Force

    $extension = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($TargetPath).ToLowerInvariant()

    if ($extension -in @(".py", ".json", ".md", ".txt")) {
        $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($TargetPath)

        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("ask_ai_project_reasoner.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app/project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("project_reasoner_v10/prompt_builder", "reasoner_engine/prompt_builder")
        $text = $text.Replace("project_reasoner_v10\prompt_builder", "reasoner_engine\prompt_builder")

        Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $TargetPath -Text $text
    }
}

function Restore-ReasonerEnginePromptBuilderMigrationPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }
            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR)) {
        throw "Legacy engine folder not found: $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR)) {
        throw "Canonical engine folder not found: $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $dynamicCopiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($pair in $DYNAMIC_COPY_PAIRS) {
        $sourceRelative = [string]$pair[0]
        $targetRelative = [string]$pair[1]
        $sourcePath = Join-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR $sourceRelative
        $targetPath = Join-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR $targetRelative
        $targetProjectRelative = "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine\$targetRelative"

        if (Test-Path $sourcePath) {
            Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $targetProjectRelative -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
            Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile -SourcePath $sourcePath -TargetPath $targetPath
            $dynamicCopiedFiles.Add($targetProjectRelative)
            Write-Host "Copied canonical prompt_builder file: $targetProjectRelative"
        }
    }

    $legacyHelpDir = Join-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR "prompt_builder_help"
    $canonicalHelpDir = Join-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR "prompt_builder_help"

    if (!(Test-Path $legacyHelpDir)) {
        throw "Legacy prompt_builder_help folder not found: $legacyHelpDir"
    }

    $legacyHelpFiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $legacyHelpDir -File -Recurse -Force |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*"
        }

    foreach ($sourceFile in $legacyHelpFiles) {
        $relativeInsideHelp = $sourceFile.FullName.Substring($legacyHelpDir.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $canonicalHelpDir $relativeInsideHelp
        $targetProjectRelative = Join-Path "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine\prompt_builder_help" $relativeInsideHelp

        Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $targetProjectRelative -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
        Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile -SourcePath $sourceFile.FullName -TargetPath $targetPath
        $dynamicCopiedFiles.Add($targetProjectRelative)
        Write-Host "Copied canonical prompt_builder helper: $targetProjectRelative"
    }

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        dynamic_copied_files = @($dynamicCopiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
        preserved_top_level_legacy_package = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        preserved_legacy_engine_package = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ReasonerEnginePromptBuilderMigrationPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
        preserved_top_level_legacy_package = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        preserved_legacy_engine_package = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ReasonerEnginePromptBuilderArchitectureProtectionPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

Complete install PowerShell

Save ZIP here:

E:\kanda_reasoner_reasoner_engine_reasoner_retriever_canonical_migration.zip

Run outside PyCharm:

$PROJECT_ROOT = "E:\kanda_reasoner"
$PATCH_NAME = "kanda_reasoner_reasoner_engine_reasoner_retriever_canonical_migration"
$ZIP_PATH = "E:\kanda_reasoner_reasoner_engine_reasoner_retriever_canonical_migration.zip"
$TEMP_DIR = Join-Path $env:TEMP $PATCH_NAME

$DRIVE_ROOT = [System.IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($PROJECT_ROOT)
$BACKUP_ROOT = Join-Path $DRIVE_ROOT "_kanda_patch_backups"
$STAMP = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$BACKUP_DIR = Join-Path $BACKUP_ROOT "${PATCH_NAME}_$STAMP"
$MANIFEST_PATH = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR "install_manifest.json"

$LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
$CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine"

$DYNAMIC_COPY_PAIRS = @(
    @("reasoner_retriever.py", "reasoner_retriever.py"),
    @("reasoner_retriever_help.json", "reasoner_retriever_help.json"),
    @("reasoner_retriever_validate_manifests.py", "reasoner_retriever_validate_manifests.py"),
    @("reasoner_retriever_refactor_notes.md", "reasoner_retriever_refactor_notes.md")
)

function Backup-FileIfPresent {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [string]$RelativePath,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath
    $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

    if ($existsBefore) {
        $OverwrittenFiles.Add($RelativePath)
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $RelativePath
        $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
    }

    if (!$existsBefore) {
        $NewlyCreatedFiles.Add($RelativePath)
    }
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile {
    param(
        [string]$SourcePath,
        [string]$TargetPath
    )

    $targetParent = Split-Path $TargetPath -Parent

    if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
    }

    Copy-Item -Path $SourcePath -Destination $TargetPath -Force

    $extension = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($TargetPath).ToLowerInvariant()

    if ($extension -in @(".py", ".json", ".md", ".txt")) {
        $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($TargetPath)

        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("ask_ai_project_reasoner.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app/project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("project_reasoner_v10/reasoner_retriever", "reasoner_engine/reasoner_retriever")
        $text = $text.Replace("project_reasoner_v10\reasoner_retriever", "reasoner_engine\reasoner_retriever")

        Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $TargetPath -Text $text
    }
}

function Restore-ReasonerEngineReasonerRetrieverMigrationPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }
            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR)) {
        throw "Legacy engine folder not found: $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR)) {
        throw "Canonical engine folder not found: $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $dynamicCopiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($pair in $DYNAMIC_COPY_PAIRS) {
        $sourceRelative = [string]$pair[0]
        $targetRelative = [string]$pair[1]
        $sourcePath = Join-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR $sourceRelative
        $targetPath = Join-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR $targetRelative
        $targetProjectRelative = "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine\$targetRelative"

        if (Test-Path $sourcePath) {
            Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $targetProjectRelative -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
            Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile -SourcePath $sourcePath -TargetPath $targetPath
            $dynamicCopiedFiles.Add($targetProjectRelative)
            Write-Host "Copied canonical reasoner_retriever file: $targetProjectRelative"
        }
    }

    $legacyHelpDir = Join-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR "reasoner_retriever_help"
    $canonicalHelpDir = Join-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR "reasoner_retriever_help"

    if (!(Test-Path $legacyHelpDir)) {
        throw "Legacy reasoner_retriever_help folder not found: $legacyHelpDir"
    }

    $legacyHelpFiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $legacyHelpDir -File -Recurse -Force |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*"
        }

    foreach ($sourceFile in $legacyHelpFiles) {
        $relativeInsideHelp = $sourceFile.FullName.Substring($legacyHelpDir.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $canonicalHelpDir $relativeInsideHelp
        $targetProjectRelative = Join-Path "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine\reasoner_retriever_help" $relativeInsideHelp

        Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $targetProjectRelative -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
        Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile -SourcePath $sourceFile.FullName -TargetPath $targetPath
        $dynamicCopiedFiles.Add($targetProjectRelative)
        Write-Host "Copied canonical reasoner_retriever helper: $targetProjectRelative"
    }

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        dynamic_copied_files = @($dynamicCopiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
        preserved_top_level_legacy_package = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        preserved_legacy_engine_package = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ReasonerEngineReasonerRetrieverMigrationPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

$PROJECT_ROOT = "E:\kanda_reasoner"
