$ZIP_PATH = "E:\kanda_reasoner_reasoner_retriever_validation_cleanup.zip"
$TEMP_DIR = Join-Path $env:TEMP $PATCH_NAME

$DRIVE_ROOT = [System.IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($PROJECT_ROOT)
$BACKUP_ROOT = Join-Path $DRIVE_ROOT "_kanda_patch_backups"
$STAMP = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$BACKUP_DIR = Join-Path $BACKUP_ROOT "${PATCH_NAME}_$STAMP"
$MANIFEST_PATH = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR "install_manifest.json"

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Remove-Utf8BomFromTree {
    param(
        [string]$RootPath
    )

    $textExtensions = @(".py", ".json", ".md", ".txt")

    $files = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $RootPath -File -Recurse -Force |
        Where-Object {
            $textExtensions -contains ([System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($_.FullName).ToLowerInvariant())
        }

    foreach ($file in $files) {
        $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($file.FullName)

        if ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xBF) {
            $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($file.FullName)
            Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $file.FullName -Text $text
            Write-Host "Removed UTF-8 BOM: $($file.FullName)"
        }
    }
}

function Restore-ReasonerRetrieverValidationCleanupPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }
            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
        preserved_top_level_legacy_package = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        preserved_legacy_engine_package = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    Remove-Utf8BomFromTree -RootPath (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine")

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ReasonerRetrieverValidationCleanupPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

function Backup-FileIfPresent {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [string]$RelativePath,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath
    $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

    if ($existsBefore) {
        $OverwrittenFiles.Add($RelativePath)

        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $RelativePath
        $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
    }

    if (!$existsBefore) {
        $NewlyCreatedFiles.Add($RelativePath)
    }
}

$PROJECT_ROOT = "E:\kanda_reasoner"
$PATCH_NAME = "kanda_reasoner_reasoner_engine_standalone_modules_canonical_migration"
$ZIP_PATH = "E:\kanda_reasoner_reasoner_engine_standalone_modules_canonical_migration.zip"
$TEMP_DIR = Join-Path $env:TEMP $PATCH_NAME

$DRIVE_ROOT = [System.IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($PROJECT_ROOT)
$BACKUP_ROOT = Join-Path $DRIVE_ROOT "_kanda_patch_backups"
$STAMP = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$BACKUP_DIR = Join-Path $BACKUP_ROOT "${PATCH_NAME}_$STAMP"
$MANIFEST_PATH = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR "install_manifest.json"

$LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
$CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine"

$STANDALONE_FILES = @(
    "query_router.py",
    "v10_conversation_memory.py",
    "v10_intent_detection.py",
    "v10_model_registry.py",
    "v10_models.py",
    "v10_qwen_ai_models.py",
    "v10_scoring_config.py"
)

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Backup-FileIfPresent {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [string]$RelativePath,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath
    $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

    if ($existsBefore) {
        $OverwrittenFiles.Add($RelativePath)

        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $RelativePath
        $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
    }

    if (!$existsBefore) {
        $NewlyCreatedFiles.Add($RelativePath)
    }
}

function Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile {
    param(
        [string]$SourcePath,
        [string]$TargetPath
    )

    $targetParent = Split-Path $TargetPath -Parent

    if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
    }

    Copy-Item -Path $SourcePath -Destination $TargetPath -Force

    $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($TargetPath)
    $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
    $text = $text.Replace("ask_ai_project_reasoner.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
    $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app/project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_engine")
    $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine")

    Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $TargetPath -Text $text
}

function Restore-ReasonerEngineStandaloneModulesMigrationPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR)) {
        throw "Legacy engine folder not found: $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR)) {
        throw "Canonical engine folder not found: $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $dynamicCopiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($fileName in $STANDALONE_FILES) {
        $sourcePath = Join-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR $fileName
        $targetPath = Join-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR $fileName
        $targetProjectRelative = "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine\$fileName"

        if (!(Test-Path $sourcePath)) {
            throw "Required legacy standalone module not found: $sourcePath"
        }

        Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $targetProjectRelative -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
        Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile -SourcePath $sourcePath -TargetPath $targetPath

        $dynamicCopiedFiles.Add($targetProjectRelative)
        Write-Host "Copied canonical standalone module: $targetProjectRelative"
    }

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $relativePath -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles

        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        dynamic_copied_files = @($dynamicCopiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
        preserved_top_level_legacy_package = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        preserved_legacy_engine_package = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ReasonerEngineStandaloneModulesMigrationPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

    }

    Copy-Item -Path $SourcePath -Destination $TargetPath -Force

    $extension = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($TargetPath).ToLowerInvariant()

    if ($extension -in @(".py", ".json", ".md", ".txt")) {

    }
}

function Add-Unique {
    param(
        [object]$List,
        [string]$Item
    )

    if (!$List.Contains($Item)) {
        $List.Add($Item)
    }
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Backup-FileIfPresent {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [string]$RelativePath,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath
    $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

    if ($existsBefore) {
        Add-Unique -List $OverwrittenFiles -Item $RelativePath

        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $RelativePath
        $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
    }

    if (!$existsBefore) {
        Add-Unique -List $NewlyCreatedFiles -Item $RelativePath
    }
}

function Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile {
    param(
        [string]$SourcePath,
        [string]$TargetPath
    )

    $targetParent = Split-Path $TargetPath -Parent

    if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
    }

    Copy-Item -Path $SourcePath -Destination $TargetPath -Force

    $extension = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($TargetPath).ToLowerInvariant()

    if ($extension -in @(".py", ".json", ".md", ".txt")) {
        $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($TargetPath)

        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("ask_ai_project_reasoner.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app/project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("project_reasoner_v10/ai_reasoner_main_window", "reasoner_engine/ai_reasoner_main_window")
        $text = $text.Replace("project_reasoner_v10\ai_reasoner_main_window", "reasoner_engine\ai_reasoner_main_window")

        Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $TargetPath -Text $text
    }
}

function Find-LegacyMainWindowHelpDir {
    param(
        [string]$LegacyEngineDir
    )

    $candidateNames = @(
        "ai_reasoner_main_window_help",
        "main_window_help",
        "reasoner_main_window_help",
        "ai_main_window_help"
    )

    foreach ($name in $candidateNames) {
        $candidatePath = Join-Path $LegacyEngineDir $name

        if (Test-Path $candidatePath) {
            return $candidatePath
        }
    }

    $matchingDirs = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LegacyEngineDir -Directory -Recurse -Force |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*" -and
            (
                $_.Name -like "*main*window*help*" -or
                $_.Name -like "*ai*reasoner*main*window*help*"
            )
        } |
        Sort-Object FullName

    foreach ($dir in $matchingDirs) {
        return $dir.FullName
    }

    return ""
}

function Ensure-PackageInitFiles {
    param(
        [string]$RootDir,
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $dirs = @($RootDir)
    $dirs += Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $RootDir -Directory -Recurse -Force |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*"
        } |
        ForEach-Object {
            $_.FullName
        }

    foreach ($dir in $dirs) {
        $initPath = Join-Path $dir "__init__.py"
        $relativePath = $initPath.Substring($ProjectRoot.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")

        if (!(Test-Path $initPath)) {
            Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $ProjectRoot -BackupDir $BackupDir -RelativePath $relativePath -OverwrittenFiles $OverwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $NewlyCreatedFiles
            Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $initPath -Text '"""Canonical main window helper package."""'
            Write-Host "Created package file: $relativePath"
        }
    }
}

function Generate-MainWindowHelperTests {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$CanonicalHelpDir,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,

    )

    $canonicalTestRelative = "tests\test_reasoner_engine_main_window_helpers_canonical_migration.py"
    $directTestRelative = "tests\test_reasoner_engine_main_window_helpers_direct_imports.py"

    $canonicalTestPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $canonicalTestRelative
    $directTestPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $directTestRelative

    Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $ProjectRoot -BackupDir $BackupDir -RelativePath $canonicalTestRelative -OverwrittenFiles $OverwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $NewlyCreatedFiles
    Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $ProjectRoot -BackupDir $BackupDir -RelativePath $directTestRelative -OverwrittenFiles $OverwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $NewlyCreatedFiles

    $helperPyFiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $CanonicalHelpDir -File -Recurse -Filter "*.py" |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*"
        } |
        Sort-Object FullName

    $canonicalLines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $canonicalLines.Add('"""Focused tests for canonical main window helper migration."""')
    $canonicalLines.Add("")
    $canonicalLines.Add("from __future__ import annotations")
    $canonicalLines.Add("")
    $canonicalLines.Add("import importlib")
    $canonicalLines.Add("import unittest")
    $canonicalLines.Add("from pathlib import Path")
    $canonicalLines.Add("")
    $canonicalLines.Add("")
    $canonicalLines.Add("class ReasonerEngineMainWindowHelpersCanonicalMigrationTests(unittest.TestCase):")
    $canonicalLines.Add("    def test_canonical_helper_folder_exists(self):")
    $canonicalLines.Add("        root = Path('kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_engine/ai_reasoner_main_window_help')")
    $canonicalLines.Add("        self.assertTrue(root.exists(), str(root))")
    $canonicalLines.Add("")
    $canonicalLines.Add("    def test_legacy_gui_window_still_imports(self):")
    $canonicalLines.Add("        module = importlib.import_module('kanda_reasoner_app.project_reasoner_v10.ai_reasoner_main_window')")
    $canonicalLines.Add("        self.assertIsNotNone(module)")
    $canonicalLines.Add("")
    $canonicalLines.Add("    def test_canonical_helper_package_imports(self):")
    $canonicalLines.Add("        module = importlib.import_module('kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine.ai_reasoner_main_window_help')")
    $canonicalLines.Add("        self.assertIsNotNone(module)")
    $canonicalLines.Add("")
    $canonicalLines.Add("")
    $canonicalLines.Add("if __name__ == '__main__':")
    $canonicalLines.Add("    unittest.main()")

    $directLines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $directLines.Add('"""Direct import protection for canonical main window helper modules."""')
    $directLines.Add("")
    $directLines.Add("from __future__ import annotations")
    $directLines.Add("")
    $index = 0

    foreach ($helperFile in $helperPyFiles) {
        $relativeModulePath = $helperFile.FullName.Substring($CanonicalHelpDir.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $moduleName = $relativeModulePath -replace "\.py$", ""
        $moduleName = $moduleName.Replace("\", ".").Replace("/", ".")

        if ($moduleName.EndsWith(".__init__")) {
            $moduleName = $moduleName.Substring(0, $moduleName.Length - 9)
        }

        if ($moduleName -eq "__init__") {
            $moduleName = ""
        }

        $fullModuleName = "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine.ai_reasoner_main_window_help"

        if ($moduleName.Length -gt 0) {
            $fullModuleName = "$fullModuleName.$moduleName"
        }

        $directLines.Add("import $fullModuleName as direct_import_$index")
        $index = $index + 1
    }

    $directLines.Add("")
    $directLines.Add("import unittest")
    $directLines.Add("")
    $directLines.Add("")
    $directLines.Add("class ReasonerEngineMainWindowHelperDirectImportTests(unittest.TestCase):")
    $directLines.Add("    def test_main_window_helper_direct_imports_are_loaded(self):")
    $directLines.Add("        self.assertGreaterEqual($index, 1)")
    $directLines.Add("")
    $directLines.Add("")
    $directLines.Add("if __name__ == '__main__':")
    $directLines.Add("    unittest.main()")

    $testParent = Split-Path $canonicalTestPath -Parent

    if (!(Test-Path $testParent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $testParent -Force | Out-Null
    }

    Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $canonicalTestPath -Text ($canonicalLines -join [Environment]::NewLine)
    Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $directTestPath -Text ($directLines -join [Environment]::NewLine)

    Write-Host "Generated test: $canonicalTestRelative"
    Write-Host "Generated test: $directTestRelative"
}

function Restore-MainWindowHelpersApplyRepairPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR)) {
        throw "Legacy engine folder not found: $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR)) {
        throw "Canonical engine folder not found: $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR"
    }

    $LEGACY_HELP_DIR = Find-LegacyMainWindowHelpDir -LegacyEngineDir $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR

    if ($LEGACY_HELP_DIR.Length -eq 0) {
        Write-Host "Available legacy engine directories:"
        Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR -Directory | Select-Object Name
        throw "Could not find a legacy main window helper folder under: $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR"
    }

    Write-Host "Using legacy main window helper folder:"
    Write-Host $LEGACY_HELP_DIR

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $dynamicCopiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    $legacyHelpFiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LEGACY_HELP_DIR -File -Recurse -Force |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*"
        }

    foreach ($sourceFile in $legacyHelpFiles) {
        $relativeInsideHelp = $sourceFile.FullName.Substring($LEGACY_HELP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $CANONICAL_HELP_DIR $relativeInsideHelp
        $relativePath = Join-Path "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine\ai_reasoner_main_window_help" $relativeInsideHelp

        Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $relativePath -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
        Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile -SourcePath $sourceFile.FullName -TargetPath $targetPath

        Add-Unique -List $dynamicCopiedFiles -Item $relativePath
        Write-Host "Copied canonical main_window helper: $relativePath"
    }

    Ensure-PackageInitFiles -RootDir $CANONICAL_HELP_DIR -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles

    Generate-MainWindowHelperTests -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -CanonicalHelpDir $CANONICAL_HELP_DIR -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
    Add-Unique -List $dynamicCopiedFiles -Item "tests\test_reasoner_engine_main_window_helpers_canonical_migration.py"
    Add-Unique -List $dynamicCopiedFiles -Item "tests\test_reasoner_engine_main_window_helpers_direct_imports.py"

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath

        Add-Unique -List $copiedFiles -Item $relativePath
        Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $relativePath -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles

        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        dynamic_copied_files = @($dynamicCopiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        legacy_help_dir_used = $LEGACY_HELP_DIR
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
        preserved_top_level_legacy_package = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        preserved_legacy_engine_package = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
        intentionally_not_moved = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10\ai_reasoner_main_window.py"
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-MainWindowHelpersApplyRepairPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Backup-FileIfPresent {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [string]$RelativePath,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath
    $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

    if ($existsBefore) {
        $OverwrittenFiles.Add($RelativePath)

        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $RelativePath
        $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
    }

    if (!$existsBefore) {
        $NewlyCreatedFiles.Add($RelativePath)
    }
}

}

    }

    Copy-Item -Path $LEGACY_MAIN -Destination $CANONICAL_MAIN -Force

    $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($CANONICAL_MAIN)
    $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
    $text = $text.Replace("ask_ai_project_reasoner.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")

    $text = $text.Replace("project_reasoner_v10/ai_reasoner_main_window", "reasoner_engine/ai_reasoner_main_window")
    $text = $text.Replace("project_reasoner_v10\ai_reasoner_main_window", "reasoner_engine\ai_reasoner_main_window")

    Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $CANONICAL_MAIN -Text $text

    $dynamicCopiedFiles.Add($canonicalRelative)
    Write-Host "Copied canonical GUI main window: $canonicalRelative"

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $relativePath -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles

        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        dynamic_copied_files = @($dynamicCopiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
        preserved_top_level_legacy_package = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        preserved_legacy_engine_package = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
        intentionally_not_deleted = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10\ai_reasoner_main_window.py"
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-MainWindowGuiCanonicalMigrationPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

function Restore-MainWindowGuiRegressionCleanupPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
        preserved_top_level_legacy_package = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        preserved_legacy_engine_package = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
        repair_reason = "Update old facade regression test to accept list or tuple __all__ after canonical GUI migration."
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-MainWindowGuiRegressionCleanupPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Backup-FileIfPresent {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [string]$RelativePath,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath
    $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

    if ($existsBefore) {
        $OverwrittenFiles.Add($RelativePath)

        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $RelativePath
        $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
    }

    if (!$existsBefore) {
        $NewlyCreatedFiles.Add($RelativePath)
    }
}

function Restore-RuntimeReferenceSweepPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

function Restore-FinalCompatibilityAuditPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
        preserved_top_level_legacy_package = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        preserved_legacy_engine_package = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
        mode = "read_only_final_compatibility_audit"
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-FinalCompatibilityAuditPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($fileName in $ROOT_FILES) {

        $targetPath = Join-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR $fileName

        if (Test-Path $sourcePath) {

            Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile -SourcePath $sourcePath -TargetPath $targetPath
            $dynamicCopiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

    $requiredCanonical = Join-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR "v10_static_context_dialog.py"
    if (!(Test-Path $requiredCanonical)) {

    }

    $legacyHelpDir = Join-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR "v10_static_context_dialog_help"
    $canonicalHelpDir = Join-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR "v10_static_context_dialog_help"

    if (Test-Path $legacyHelpDir) {
        $legacyHelpFiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $legacyHelpDir -File -Recurse -Force |
            Where-Object {
                $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*"
            }

        foreach ($sourceFile in $legacyHelpFiles) {
            $relativeInsideHelp = $sourceFile.FullName.Substring($legacyHelpDir.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
            $targetPath = Join-Path $canonicalHelpDir $relativeInsideHelp
            $relativePath = Join-Path "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine\v10_static_context_dialog_help" $relativeInsideHelp

            Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $relativePath -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
            Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile -SourcePath $sourceFile.FullName -TargetPath $targetPath
            $dynamicCopiedFiles.Add($relativePath)
            Write-Host "Copied canonical static context helper: $relativePath"
        }
    }

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        dynamic_copied_files = @($dynamicCopiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)

        deleted_files = @()

        )
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-V10StaticContextDialogMigrationPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Backup-FileIfPresent {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [string]$RelativePath,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath
    $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

    if ($existsBefore) {
        $OverwrittenFiles.Add($RelativePath)

        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $RelativePath
        $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
    }

    if (!$existsBefore) {
        $NewlyCreatedFiles.Add($RelativePath)
    }
}

function Ensure-PackageInitFiles {
    param(

        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    if (!(Test-Path $RootDir)) {

    $dirs = @($RootDir)
    $dirs += Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $RootDir -Directory -Recurse -Force |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*"
        } |
        ForEach-Object {
            $_.FullName
        }

    foreach ($dir in $dirs) {
        $initPath = Join-Path $dir "__init__.py"
        $relativePath = $initPath.Substring($ProjectRoot.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")

        if (!(Test-Path $initPath)) {
            Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $ProjectRoot -BackupDir $BackupDir -RelativePath $relativePath -OverwrittenFiles $OverwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $NewlyCreatedFiles

    }

catch {

        Restore-V10StaticContextInspectorWidgetMigrationPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Backup-FileIfPresent {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [string]$RelativePath,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath
    $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

    if ($existsBefore) {
        $OverwrittenFiles.Add($RelativePath)

        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $RelativePath
        $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
    }

    if (!$existsBefore) {
        $NewlyCreatedFiles.Add($RelativePath)
    }
}

function Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile {
    param(
        [string]$SourcePath,
        [string]$TargetPath
    )

    $targetParent = Split-Path $TargetPath -Parent

    if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
    }

    Copy-Item -Path $SourcePath -Destination $TargetPath -Force

    $extension = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($TargetPath).ToLowerInvariant()

    if ($extension -in @(".py", ".json", ".md", ".txt")) {
        $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($TargetPath)

        $text = $text.Replace("ask_ai_project_reasoner.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("ask_ai_project_reasoner/project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app/project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("ask_ai_project_reasoner\project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine")
        $text = $text.Replace("kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine")

        Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $TargetPath -Text $text
    }
}

function Ensure-PackageInitFiles {
    param(
        [string]$RootDir,
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    if (!(Test-Path $RootDir)) {
        return
    }

    $dirs = @($RootDir)
    $dirs += Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $RootDir -Directory -Recurse -Force |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*"
        } |
        ForEach-Object {
            $_.FullName
        }

    foreach ($dir in $dirs) {
        $initPath = Join-Path $dir "__init__.py"
        $relativePath = $initPath.Substring($ProjectRoot.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")

        if (!(Test-Path $initPath)) {
            Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $ProjectRoot -BackupDir $Backup_DIR -RelativePath $relativePath -OverwrittenFiles $OverwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $NewlyCreatedFiles
            Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $initPath -Text '"""Canonical static context evidence formatter helper package."""'
            Write-Host "Created package file: $relativePath"
        }
    }
}

function Generate-DirectImportTest {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$CanonicalEngineDir,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $testRelative = "tests\test_v10_static_context_evidence_formatter_direct_imports.py"
    $testPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $testRelative

    Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $ProjectRoot -BackupDir $BackupDir -RelativePath $testRelative -OverwrittenFiles $OverwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $NewlyCreatedFiles

    $lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $lines.Add('"""Direct import protection for canonical static context evidence formatter modules."""')
    $lines.Add("")
    $lines.Add("from __future__ import annotations")
    $lines.Add("")
    $lines.Add("import kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine.v10_static_context_evidence_formatter as direct_import_0")

    $helpDir = Join-Path $CanonicalEngineDir "v10_static_context_evidence_formatter_help"

    if (Test-Path $helpDir) {
        $helperFiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $helpDir -File -Recurse -Filter "*.py" |
            Where-Object {
                $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*"
            } |
            Sort-Object FullName

        $index = 1

        foreach ($helperFile in $helperFiles) {
            $relativeModulePath = $helperFile.FullName.Substring($helpDir.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
            $moduleName = $relativeModulePath -replace "\.py$", ""
            $moduleName = $moduleName.Replace("\", ".").Replace("/", ".")

            if ($moduleName.EndsWith(".__init__")) {
                $moduleName = $moduleName.Substring(0, $moduleName.Length - 9)
            }

            if ($moduleName -eq "__init__") {
                $moduleName = ""
            }

            $fullModuleName = "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine.v10_static_context_evidence_formatter_help"

            if ($moduleName.Length -gt 0) {
                $fullModuleName = "$fullModuleName.$moduleName"
            }

            $lines.Add("import $fullModuleName as direct_import_$index")
            $index = $index + 1
        }
    }

    $lines.Add("")
    $lines.Add("import unittest")
    $lines.Add("")
    $lines.Add("")
    $lines.Add("class V10StaticContextEvidenceFormatterDirectImportTests(unittest.TestCase):")
    $lines.Add("    def test_direct_imports_are_loaded(self):")
    $lines.Add("        self.assertTrue(True)")
    $lines.Add("")
    $lines.Add("")
    $lines.Add("if __name__ == '__main__':")
    $lines.Add("    unittest.main()")

    $testParent = Split-Path $testPath -Parent

    if (!(Test-Path $testParent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $testParent -Force | Out-Null
    }

    Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $testPath -Text ($lines -join [Environment]::NewLine)
    Write-Host "Generated direct import test: $testRelative"
}

function Restore-V10StaticContextEvidenceFormatterMigrationPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

    }

    if (!(Test-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR)) {
        throw "Legacy engine folder not found: $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR)) {
        throw "Canonical engine folder not found: $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $dynamicCopiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($fileName in $ROOT_FILES) {
        $sourcePath = Join-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR $fileName
        $targetPath = Join-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR $fileName
        $relativePath = "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine\$fileName"

        if (Test-Path $sourcePath) {

            Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile -SourcePath $sourcePath -TargetPath $targetPath
            $dynamicCopiedFiles.Add($relativePath)
            Write-Host "Copied canonical evidence formatter file: $relativePath"
        }
    }

    $requiredCanonical = Join-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR "v10_static_context_evidence_formatter.py"
    if (!(Test-Path $requiredCanonical)) {
        throw "Required canonical file was not created: $requiredCanonical"
    }

    $legacyHelpDir = Join-Path $LEGACY_ENGINE_DIR "v10_static_context_evidence_formatter_help"
    $canonicalHelpDir = Join-Path $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR "v10_static_context_evidence_formatter_help"

    if (Test-Path $legacyHelpDir) {
        $legacyHelpFiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $legacyHelpDir -File -Recurse -Force |
            Where-Object {
                $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*"
            }

        foreach ($sourceFile in $legacyHelpFiles) {

            $targetPath = Join-Path $canonicalHelpDir $relativeInsideHelp
            $relativePath = Join-Path "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine\v10_static_context_evidence_formatter_help" $relativeInsideHelp

            Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $relativePath -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
            Copy-And-RewriteCanonicalFile -SourcePath $sourceFile.FullName -TargetPath $targetPath
            $dynamicCopiedFiles.Add($relativePath)
            Write-Host "Copied canonical evidence formatter helper: $relativePath"
        }

        Ensure-PackageInitFiles -RootDir $canonicalHelpDir -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
    }

    Generate-DirectImportTest -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -CanonicalEngineDir $CANONICAL_ENGINE_DIR -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        dynamic_copied_files = @($dynamicCopiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)

        final_delete_targets = @(
            "ask_ai_project_reasoner",
            "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
        )
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-V10StaticContextEvidenceFormatterMigrationPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

function Restore-ProjectReasonerV10ActualDeletionPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.deleted_dirs) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if ((!(Test-Path $targetPath)) -and (Test-Path $backupPath)) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Recurse -Force
            Write-Host "Restored deleted directory: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $DELETE_TARGET)) {
        throw "Delete target not found: $DELETE_TARGET"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $deletedDirs = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    $backupDeleteTarget = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $DELETE_TARGET_RELATIVE
    $backupDeleteParent = Split-Path $backupDeleteTarget -Parent

    if (!(Test-Path $backupDeleteParent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupDeleteParent -Force | Out-Null
    }

    Copy-Item -Path $DELETE_TARGET -Destination $backupDeleteTarget -Recurse -Force
    $deletedDirs.Add($DELETE_TARGET_RELATIVE)

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_dirs = @($deletedDirs)
        deleted_files = @()
        remaining_final_delete_target = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    Remove-Item -Path $DELETE_TARGET -Recurse -Force
    Write-Host "Deleted retired directory: $DELETE_TARGET_RELATIVE"

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    python -c "import importlib.util; spec = importlib.util.find_spec('kanda_reasoner_app.project_reasoner_v10'); raise SystemExit(0 if spec is None else 1)"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Retired package is still importable after deletion."
    }

    python -c "import kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine; import kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine.ai_reasoner_main_window; import kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine.query_router; import kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine.reasoner_retriever; import reasoner_tools_gui; print('canonical runtime imports ok after project_reasoner_v10 deletion')"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Canonical runtime import smoke failed after deletion."
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ProjectReasonerV10ActualDeletionPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

    "kanda_reasoner_app\run_real_project_static_context_smoke.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app\run_static_context_test_suite.py"
)

$REPLACEMENT_PAIRS = @(
    @("ask_ai_project_reasoner.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine"),
    @("kanda_reasoner_app.project_reasoner_v10", "kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine"),

)

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Backup-FileIfPresent {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [string]$RelativePath,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath
    $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

    if ($existsBefore) {
        $OverwrittenFiles.Add($RelativePath)

        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $RelativePath
        $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
    }

    if (!$existsBefore) {
        $NewlyCreatedFiles.Add($RelativePath)
    }
}

function Restore-StaticContextSmokeScriptsCanonicalPathCleanupPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $rewrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($relativePath in $TARGET_FILES) {
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath

        if (!(Test-Path $targetPath)) {
            throw "Target file not found: $relativePath"
        }

        $originalText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($targetPath)
        $newText = $originalText

        foreach ($pair in $REPLACEMENT_PAIRS) {
            $newText = $newText.Replace([string]$pair[0], [string]$pair[1])
        }

        if ($newText -ne $originalText) {
            Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $relativePath -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
            Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $targetPath -Text $newText
            $rewrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)
            Write-Host "Rewritten static-context smoke script: $relativePath"
        }
        else {
            Write-Host "No rewrite needed: $relativePath"
        }
    }

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        rewritten_files = @($rewrittenFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        repair_reason = "Rewrite static-context smoke scripts from deleted project_reasoner_v10 path to canonical reasoner_engine path."
        deleted_target = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
        remaining_final_delete_target = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-StaticContextSmokeScriptsCanonicalPathCleanupPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}
