function Restore-AskAiDeletionDryRunPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "ask_ai_project_reasoner"))) {
        throw "Dry-run target not found: ask_ai_project_reasoner"
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10")) {
        throw "Deleted engine package unexpectedly exists: kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        mode = "ask_ai_project_reasoner_deletion_dry_run"
        dry_run_target = "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        already_deleted_target = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-AskAiDeletionDryRunPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Backup-FileIfPresent {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [string]$RelativePath,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath
    $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

    if ($existsBefore) {
        $OverwrittenFiles.Add($RelativePath)

        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $RelativePath
        $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
    }

    if (!$existsBefore) {
        $NewlyCreatedFiles.Add($RelativePath)
    }
}

function Restore-GuiTabSpecsAfterProjectReasonerV10DeletionRepairPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,

    )

            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

        }

        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        rewritten_files = @($rewrittenFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()

    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

function Restore-AskAiProjectReasonerActualDeletionPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.deleted_dirs) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if ((!(Test-Path $targetPath)) -and (Test-Path $backupPath)) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Recurse -Force
            Write-Host "Restored deleted directory: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $DELETE_TARGET)) {
        throw "Delete target not found: $DELETE_TARGET"
    }

    if (Test-Path $ALREADY_DELETED_ENGINE) {
        throw "Deleted engine package unexpectedly exists: kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $deletedDirs = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    $backupDeleteTarget = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $DELETE_TARGET_RELATIVE
    Copy-Item -Path $DELETE_TARGET -Destination $backupDeleteTarget -Recurse -Force
    $deletedDirs.Add($DELETE_TARGET_RELATIVE)

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_dirs = @($deletedDirs)
        deleted_files = @()
        final_deleted_targets = @(
            "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10",
            "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        )
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    Remove-Item -Path $DELETE_TARGET -Recurse -Force
    Write-Host "Deleted retired directory: $DELETE_TARGET_RELATIVE"

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    python -c "import importlib.util; spec = importlib.util.find_spec('ask_ai_project_reasoner'); raise SystemExit(0 if spec is None else 1)"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "ask_ai_project_reasoner is still importable after deletion."
    }

    python -c "import importlib.util; spec = importlib.util.find_spec('kanda_reasoner_app.project_reasoner_v10'); raise SystemExit(0 if spec is None else 1)"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "kanda_reasoner_app.project_reasoner_v10 unexpectedly importable after final deletion."
    }

    python -c "import kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine; import kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine.ai_reasoner_main_window; import kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine.query_router; import kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine.reasoner_retriever; import reasoner_tools_gui; print('canonical runtime imports ok after final legacy deletion')"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Canonical runtime import smoke failed after final legacy deletion."
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-AskAiProjectReasonerActualDeletionPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Backup-FileIfPresent {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [string]$RelativePath,
        [object]$OverwrittenFiles,
        [object]$NewlyCreatedFiles
    )

    $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath
    $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

    if ($existsBefore) {
        $OverwrittenFiles.Add($RelativePath)

        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $RelativePath
        $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
    }

    if (!$existsBefore) {
        $NewlyCreatedFiles.Add($RelativePath)
    }
}

function Restore-FinalLegacyDeletionGuiRuntimeAliasRepairPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

function Install-DeletedLegacyRuntimeAlias {
    param(
        [string]$Text
    )

    $aliasMarker = "def _install_deleted_legacy_root_runtime_aliases()"
    if ($Text.Contains($aliasMarker)) {
        return $Text
    }

    $aliasCode = @'
def _install_deleted_legacy_root_runtime_aliases():
    """Install in-process aliases for deleted legacy payload imports."""
    import importlib
    import sys

    legacy_root_name = "ask_ai" + "_project_reasoner"
    legacy_engine_name = legacy_root_name + ".project_reasoner_v10"

    canonical_root = importlib.import_module("kanda_reasoner_app")
    sys.modules.setdefault(legacy_root_name, canonical_root)

    try:
        canonical_engine = importlib.import_module("kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        return

    sys.modules.setdefault(legacy_engine_name, canonical_engine)
    setattr(canonical_root, "project_reasoner_v10", canonical_engine)


_install_deleted_legacy_root_runtime_aliases()


'@

    $needle = "load_payload(__name__"
    if (!$Text.Contains($needle)) {
        return $Text
    }

    return $Text.Replace($needle, $aliasCode + $needle)
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "ask_ai_project_reasoner")) {
        throw "Deleted legacy root unexpectedly exists: ask_ai_project_reasoner"
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10")) {
        throw "Deleted engine package unexpectedly exists: kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $rewrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $aliasPatchedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($relativePath in $DIRECT_REWRITE_FILES) {
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath

        if (!(Test-Path $targetPath)) {
            continue
        }

        $originalText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($targetPath)
        $newText = $originalText

        foreach ($pair in $REPLACEMENT_PAIRS) {
            $newText = $newText.Replace([string]$pair[0], [string]$pair[1])
        }

        if ($newText -ne $originalText) {
            Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $relativePath -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
            Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $targetPath -Text $newText
            $rewrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)
            Write-Host "Rewritten deleted-root source reference: $relativePath"
        }
    }

    $payloadShellFiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app") -File -Recurse -Filter "*.py" |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*"
        }

    foreach ($file in $payloadShellFiles) {
        $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($file.FullName)

        if (!$text.Contains("load_payload(__name__")) {
            continue
        }

        $newText = Install-DeletedLegacyRuntimeAlias -Text $text

        if ($newText -ne $text) {
            $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($PROJECT_ROOT.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
            Backup-FileIfPresent -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -RelativePath $relativePath -OverwrittenFiles $overwrittenFiles -NewlyCreatedFiles $newlyCreatedFiles
            Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $file.FullName -Text $newText
            $aliasPatchedFiles.Add($relativePath)
            Write-Host "Patched payload runtime alias: $relativePath"
        }
    }

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        rewritten_files = @($rewrittenFiles)
        alias_patched_files = @($aliasPatchedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        repair_reason = "Patch GUI/runtime embedded payloads to resolve deleted ask_ai_project_reasoner imports through canonical in-process aliases."
        final_deleted_targets = @(
            "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10",
            "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        )
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    python -c "import importlib.util; spec = importlib.util.find_spec('ask_ai_project_reasoner'); raise SystemExit(0 if spec is None else 1)"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "ask_ai_project_reasoner unexpectedly importable after repair."
    }

    python -c "import importlib.util; spec = importlib.util.find_spec('kanda_reasoner_app.project_reasoner_v10'); raise SystemExit(0 if spec is None else 1)"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "project_reasoner_v10 unexpectedly importable after repair."
    }

    python -c "import kanda_reasoner_app.manage_architecture.manage_architecture_gui; import kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_tools_shell.runner; import reasoner_tools_gui; print('GUI runtime imports ok after final legacy deletion alias repair')"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "GUI runtime import smoke failed after alias repair."
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-FinalLegacyDeletionGuiRuntimeAliasRepairPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import os
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(os.environ["KR_PATCH_ROOT"])
targets = [item for item in os.environ["KR_PATCH_TARGETS"].split("|") if item]

alias_code = '''
def _install_deleted_legacy_root_importlib_aliases():
    """Install in-process aliases for deleted legacy payload imports."""
    import importlib
    import sys

    legacy_root_name = "ask_ai" + "_project_reasoner"
    legacy_engine_name = legacy_root_name + ".project_reasoner_v10"

    canonical_root = importlib.import_module("kanda_reasoner_app")
    sys.modules.setdefault(legacy_root_name, canonical_root)

    try:
        canonical_engine = importlib.import_module("kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_engine")
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        return

    sys.modules.setdefault(legacy_engine_name, canonical_engine)
    setattr(canonical_root, "project_reasoner_v10", canonical_engine)


_install_deleted_legacy_root_importlib_aliases()


'''.lstrip()


def find_insert_line(text: str) -> int:
    tree = ast.parse(text)
    insert_line = 0
    body = list(tree.body)

    if body:
        first = body[0]
        if (
            isinstance(first, ast.Expr)
            and isinstance(first.value, ast.Constant)
            and isinstance(first.value.value, str)
        ):
            insert_line = getattr(first, "end_lineno", 1)

    for node in body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module == "__future__":
            insert_line = max(insert_line, getattr(node, "end_lineno", node.lineno))

    return insert_line


for relative in targets:
    path = root / relative
    if not path.exists():
        continue

    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

    if "_install_deleted_legacy_root_importlib_aliases" in text:
        continue

    insert_line = find_insert_line(text)
    lines = text.splitlines()
    new_lines = lines[:insert_line] + alias_code.rstrip().splitlines() + [""] + lines[insert_line:]
    path.write_text("\n".join(new_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print("Patched deleted legacy importlib alias:", relative)

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Restore-ReasonerContextCollectorFolderRenamePatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.renamed_dirs) {
        $oldRelative = [string]$item.old_relative
        $newRelative = [string]$item.new_relative
        $oldPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $oldRelative
        $newPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $newRelative
        $backupOldPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $oldRelative

        if (Test-Path $newPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $newPath -Recurse -Force
            Write-Host "Removed renamed directory: $newPath"
        }

        if ((!(Test-Path $oldPath)) -and (Test-Path $backupOldPath)) {
            $oldParent = Split-Path $oldPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $oldParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $oldParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupOldPath -Destination $oldPath -Recurse -Force
            Write-Host "Restored original directory: $oldPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

        throw "Deleted engine package unexpectedly exists: kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10_data_collector")) {
        throw "Old collector folder unexpectedly exists: kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10_data_collector"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_context_collector"))) {
        throw "Canonical collector folder missing: kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_context_collector"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine"))) {
        throw "Canonical reasoner engine missing: kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        mode = "read_only_final_migration_freeze_audit"
        final_deleted_targets = @(
            "ask_ai_project_reasoner",
            "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
        )
        final_renamed_targets = @(
            "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10_data_collector -> kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_context_collector"
        )
        canonical_engine = "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine"
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-FinalMigrationFreezeAuditPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Restore-ReasonerRuntimeCollectorFolderRenamePatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.renamed_dirs) {
        $oldRelative = [string]$item.old_relative
        $newRelative = [string]$item.new_relative
        $oldPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $oldRelative
        $newPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $newRelative
        $backupOldPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $oldRelative

        if (Test-Path $newPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $newPath -Recurse -Force
            Write-Host "Removed renamed directory: $newPath"
        }

        if ((!(Test-Path $oldPath)) -and (Test-Path $backupOldPath)) {
            $oldParent = Split-Path $oldPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $oldParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $oldParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupOldPath -Destination $oldPath -Recurse -Force
            Write-Host "Restored original directory: $oldPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {

        }

        $newParent = Split-Path $NEW_PATH -Parent
        if (!(Test-Path $newParent)) {

        }

        Move-Item -Path $OLD_PATH -Destination $NEW_PATH

        $renamedDirs.Add([ordered]@{

            new_relative = $NEW_RELATIVE

function Restore-ReasonerRuntimeCollectorPresenceRepairPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "ask_ai_project_reasoner")) {
        throw "Deleted legacy root unexpectedly exists: ask_ai_project_reasoner"
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10")) {
        throw "Deleted engine package unexpectedly exists: kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10_runtime_collector")) {
        throw "Old runtime collector folder still exists: kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10_runtime_collector"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        repair_reason = "Create canonical reasoner_runtime_collector runner, add missing focused test, and fix final freeze audit alias semantics."
        renamed_runtime_collector = [ordered]@{
            from = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10_runtime_collector"
            to = "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_runtime_collector"
        }
        final_deleted_targets = @(
            "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10",
            "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        )
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    python -m py_compile `
        kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_runtime_collector\runner.py `
        tests\test_reasoner_runtime_collector_folder_rename.py `
        tests\test_reasoner_final_migration_freeze_audit.py

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {

    }

    python -c "import kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_runtime_collector.runner; print('reasoner_runtime_collector runner import ok')"

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "reasoner_runtime_collector runner import failed after repair."
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ReasonerRuntimeCollectorPresenceRepairPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

function Restore-RuntimeCollectorRunnerTestProtectionPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_runtime_collector\runner.py"))) {
        throw "Runtime collector runner not found."
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "ask_ai_project_reasoner")) {
        throw "Deleted legacy root unexpectedly exists: ask_ai_project_reasoner"
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10")) {
        throw "Deleted engine package unexpectedly exists: kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10_runtime_collector")) {
        throw "Old runtime collector folder still exists."
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        repair_reason = "Add direct focused test for reasoner_runtime_collector runner to close TEST_PROTECTION_GAP."
        protected_module = "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_runtime_collector\runner.py"
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    python -m py_compile tests\test_reasoner_runtime_collector_runner_direct_import.py
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "py_compile failed for direct runtime collector runner test."
    }

    python -m unittest tests.test_reasoner_runtime_collector_runner_direct_import -v
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Direct runtime collector runner test failed."
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-RuntimeCollectorRunnerTestProtectionPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Restore-ReasonerSymbolAtlasFolderRenamePatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.renamed_dirs) {
        $oldRelative = [string]$item.old_relative
        $newRelative = [string]$item.new_relative
        $oldPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $oldRelative
        $newPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $newRelative
        $backupOldPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $oldRelative

        if (Test-Path $newPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $newPath -Recurse -Force
            Write-Host "Removed renamed directory: $newPath"
        }

        if ((!(Test-Path $oldPath)) -and (Test-Path $backupOldPath)) {
            $oldParent = Split-Path $oldPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $oldParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $oldParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupOldPath -Destination $oldPath -Recurse -Force
            Write-Host "Restored original directory: $oldPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "ask_ai_project_reasoner")) {

    if ((!(Test-Path $OLD_PATH)) -and (!(Test-Path $NEW_PATH))) {
        throw "Neither old nor new symbol atlas folder exists."
    }

    if ((Test-Path $OLD_PATH) -and (Test-Path $NEW_PATH)) {
        throw "Both old and new symbol atlas folders exist. Resolve manually before running this patch."
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $rewrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $renamedDirs = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]

    if (Test-Path $OLD_PATH) {
        $backupOldPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $OLD_RELATIVE
        $backupOldParent = Split-Path $backupOldPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $backupOldParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupOldParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $OLD_PATH -Destination $backupOldPath -Recurse -Force

        $newParent = Split-Path $NEW_PATH -Parent
        if (!(Test-Path $newParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $newParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Move-Item -Path $OLD_PATH -Destination $NEW_PATH

        $renamedDirs.Add([ordered]@{
            old_relative = $OLD_RELATIVE
            new_relative = $NEW_RELATIVE
        })

        Write-Host "Renamed folder: $OLD_RELATIVE to $NEW_RELATIVE"
    }
    else {
        Write-Host "Folder already renamed: $NEW_RELATIVE"
    }

    $sourceFiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $PROJECT_ROOT -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*" -and
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\.git\*" -and
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\_kanda_patch_backups\*" -and
            $_.FullName -notlike "$TEMP_DIR*" -and
            $_.Extension.ToLowerInvariant() -in @(".py", ".json", ".md", ".txt", ".yml", ".yaml", ".ps1")
        }

    foreach ($file in $sourceFiles) {
        $originalText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($file.FullName)
        $newText = $originalText

        foreach ($pair in $REPLACEMENT_PAIRS) {
            $newText = $newText.Replace([string]$pair[0], [string]$pair[1])
        }

        if ($newText -ne $originalText) {
            $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($PROJECT_ROOT.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            if (!(Test-Path $backupPath)) {
                Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $backupPath -Force
            }

            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)
            Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $file.FullName -Text $newText
            $rewrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)
            Write-Host "Rewritten symbol atlas reference: $relativePath"
        }
    }

    if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $NEW_PATH "__init__.py"))) {
        Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath (Join-Path $NEW_PATH "__init__.py") -Text '"""Canonical reasoner symbol atlas package."""'
        $newlyCreatedFiles.Add("$NEW_RELATIVE\__init__.py")
        Write-Host "Created package initializer: $NEW_RELATIVE\__init__.py"
    }

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            if (!(Test-Path $backupPath)) {
                Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
            }
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        rewritten_files = @($rewrittenFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        renamed_dirs = @($renamedDirs)
        deleted_files = @()
        rename = [ordered]@{
            from = $OLD_RELATIVE
            to = $NEW_RELATIVE
        }
        final_deleted_targets = @(
            "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10",
            "ask_ai_project_reasoner"
        )
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    python -m py_compile tests\test_reasoner_symbol_atlas_folder_rename.py

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "py_compile failed after symbol atlas rename."
    }

    python -c "import kanda_reasoner_app.reasoner_symbol_atlas; print('reasoner_symbol_atlas import ok')"

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "reasoner_symbol_atlas import smoke failed."
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ReasonerSymbolAtlasFolderRenamePatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

$MANIFEST_PATH = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR "install_manifest.json"

function Restore-SymbolAtlasTestProtectionRepairPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_symbol_atlas"))) {
        throw "Canonical reasoner_symbol_atlas folder missing."
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\project_symbol_atlas")) {
        throw "Old project_symbol_atlas folder unexpectedly exists."
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "ask_ai_project_reasoner")) {
        throw "Deleted legacy root unexpectedly exists: ask_ai_project_reasoner"
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10")) {
        throw "Deleted engine package unexpectedly exists: kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        repair_reason = "Add symbol atlas rename test and direct tests for symbol atlas integration public modules."
        protected_modules = @(
            "kanda_reasoner_app\engineering_safety\project_symbol_atlas_integration.py",
            "kanda_reasoner_app\safety_suite_cli\project_symbol_atlas_commands.py"
        )
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    python -m py_compile `
        tests\test_reasoner_symbol_atlas_folder_rename.py `
        tests\test_project_symbol_atlas_integration_direct_import.py `
        tests\test_project_symbol_atlas_commands_direct_import.py

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "py_compile failed for symbol atlas test protection repair."
    }

    python -m unittest `
        tests.test_reasoner_symbol_atlas_folder_rename `
        tests.test_project_symbol_atlas_integration_direct_import `
        tests.test_project_symbol_atlas_commands_direct_import -v

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Symbol atlas test protection repair focused tests failed."
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-SymbolAtlasTestProtectionRepairPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

E:\kanda_reasoner_cleanup_candidates_audit.zip

Run:

$PROJECT_ROOT = "E:\kanda_reasoner"
$PATCH_NAME = "kanda_reasoner_cleanup_candidates_audit"
$ZIP_PATH = "E:\kanda_reasoner_cleanup_candidates_audit.zip"
$TEMP_DIR = Join-Path $env:TEMP $PATCH_NAME

$DRIVE_ROOT = [System.IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($PROJECT_ROOT)
$BACKUP_ROOT = Join-Path $DRIVE_ROOT "_kanda_patch_backups"
$STAMP = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$BACKUP_DIR = Join-Path $BACKUP_ROOT "${PATCH_NAME}_$STAMP"
$MANIFEST_PATH = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR "install_manifest.json"

function Restore-CleanupCandidatesAuditPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        mode = "read_only_cleanup_candidates_audit"
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    python -m py_compile `
        tools\kanda_cleanup_audit.py `
        tests\test_kanda_cleanup_audit.py

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "py_compile failed for cleanup audit."
    }

    python -m unittest tests.test_kanda_cleanup_audit -v

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "cleanup audit focused tests failed."
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-CleanupCandidatesAuditPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

$PROJECT_ROOT = "E:\kanda_reasoner"

$failed = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

$cacheDirs = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $PROJECT_ROOT -Directory -Recurse -Force |
    Where-Object {
        $_.Name -in @("__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".mypy_cache", ".ruff_cache", "htmlcov")

        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dir.FullName -Recurse -Force

}

E:\kanda_reasoner_stale_renamed_folders_cleanup.zip

Run:

$PROJECT_ROOT = "E:\kanda_reasoner"
$PATCH_NAME = "kanda_reasoner_stale_renamed_folders_cleanup"
$ZIP_PATH = "E:\kanda_reasoner_stale_renamed_folders_cleanup.zip"
$TEMP_DIR = Join-Path $env:TEMP $PATCH_NAME

$DRIVE_ROOT = [System.IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($PROJECT_ROOT)
$BACKUP_ROOT = Join-Path $DRIVE_ROOT "_kanda_patch_backups"
$STAMP = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$BACKUP_DIR = Join-Path $BACKUP_ROOT "${PATCH_NAME}_$STAMP"
$MANIFEST_PATH = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR "install_manifest.json"

function Restore-StaleRenamedFoldersCleanupPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.deleted_dirs) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir "deleted_folders\$relativePath"

        if ((!(Test-Path $targetPath)) -and (Test-Path $backupPath)) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Recurse -Force
            Write-Host "Restored deleted folder: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    foreach ($canonical in @(
        "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_engine",
        "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_context_collector",
        "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_runtime_collector",
        "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_symbol_atlas"
    )) {
        if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $canonical))) {
            throw "Canonical folder missing: $canonical"
        }
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $deletedDirs = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $staleFolders = @(
        "ask_ai_project_reasoner",
        "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10",
        "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10_data_collector",
        "kanda_reasoner_app\project_reasoner_v10_runtime_collector",
        "kanda_reasoner_app\project_symbol_atlas"
    )

    foreach ($relativePath in $staleFolders) {
        if ($relativePath.StartsWith(".project_reference")) {
            throw "Refusing to delete .project_reference path: $relativePath"
        }

        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            if (!(Get-Item $targetPath).PSIsContainer) {
                throw "Stale target exists but is not a folder: $relativePath"
            }

            $folderBackupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR "deleted_folders\$relativePath"
            $folderBackupParent = Split-Path $folderBackupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $folderBackupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $folderBackupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $folderBackupPath -Recurse -Force
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Recurse -Force

            $deletedDirs.Add($relativePath)
            Write-Host "Deleted stale renamed folder: $relativePath"
        }
        else {
            Write-Host "Already absent: $relativePath"
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_dirs = @($deletedDirs)
        deleted_files = @()
        mode = "stale_active_renamed_folder_cleanup"
        skipped_reference_archives = @(".project_reference")
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    python -m py_compile `
        tools\kanda_stale_folder_cleanup.py `
        tests\test_kanda_stale_folder_cleanup.py

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "py_compile failed for stale folder cleanup."
    }

    python -m unittest tests.test_kanda_stale_folder_cleanup -v

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "stale folder cleanup tests failed."
    }

    python tools\kanda_stale_folder_cleanup.py --root "$PROJECT_ROOT"

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "stale folder cleanup report failed."
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-StaleRenamedFoldersCleanupPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

3. Ignore .project_reference during that scan.

5. Delete only that exact active-tree folder.
6. Refuse deletion if active references still exist, unless explicitly overridden.
