            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $TARGET_RELATIVE = "kanda_reasoner_app\project_context_bundle"
    $TARGET_PATH = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $TARGET_RELATIVE

    $activeReferences = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $referenceTokens = @(
        "kanda_reasoner_app.project_context_bundle",
        "kanda_reasoner_app/project_context_bundle",
        "kanda_reasoner_app\project_context_bundle",
        "project_context_bundle"
    )

    $sourceFiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $PROJECT_ROOT -File -Recurse -Force |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\.git\*" -and
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\__pycache__\*" -and
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\_kanda_patch_backups\*" -and
            $_.FullName -notlike "*\.project_reference\*" -and
            $_.Extension.ToLowerInvariant() -in @(".py", ".json", ".md", ".txt", ".yml", ".yaml", ".ps1")
        }

    foreach ($file in $sourceFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($PROJECT_ROOT.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")

        if ($relativePath -in @(
            "tools\kanda_project_context_bundle_cleanup.py",
            "tests\test_kanda_project_context_bundle_cleanup.py"
        )) {
            continue
        }

        $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($file.FullName)

        foreach ($token in $referenceTokens) {
            if ($text.Contains($token)) {
                $activeReferences.Add($relativePath + ": " + $token)
                break
            }
        }
    }

    if ($activeReferences.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Host "DELETE BLOCKED"
        Write-Host "Active project_context_bundle references were found:"
        foreach ($item in $activeReferences) {
            Write-Host "  $item"
        }
        throw "Refusing to delete kanda_reasoner_app\project_context_bundle while active references exist."
    }

    if (Test-Path $TARGET_PATH) {
        if (!(Get-Item $TARGET_PATH).PSIsContainer) {
            throw "Target exists but is not a folder: $TARGET_RELATIVE"
        }

        $folderBackupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR "deleted_folders\$TARGET_RELATIVE"
        $folderBackupParent = Split-Path $folderBackupPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $folderBackupParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $folderBackupParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $TARGET_PATH -Destination $folderBackupPath -Recurse -Force
        Remove-Item -Path $TARGET_PATH -Recurse -Force
        $deletedDirs.Add($TARGET_RELATIVE)

        Write-Host "Deleted stale folder: $TARGET_RELATIVE"
    }
    else {
        Write-Host "Already absent: $TARGET_RELATIVE"
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        deleted_dirs = @($deletedDirs)
        deleted_files = @()
        target_deleted_folder = $TARGET_RELATIVE
        preserved_paths = @(".project_reference")
        active_reference_count = $activeReferences.Count
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    python -m py_compile `
        tools\kanda_project_context_bundle_cleanup.py `
        tests\test_kanda_project_context_bundle_cleanup.py

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "py_compile failed for project_context_bundle deletion gate."
    }

    python -m unittest tests.test_kanda_project_context_bundle_cleanup -v

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "project_context_bundle deletion gate tests failed."
    }

    python tools\kanda_project_context_bundle_cleanup.py --root "$PROJECT_ROOT"

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "project_context_bundle deletion gate report failed."
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-ProjectContextBundleDeletionGatePatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Restore-Tab4RuntimeRunnerPathRepairPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Restore-RuntimeRunnerPayloadAliasRepairPatch {
    param(

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.deleted_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir "deleted_files\$relativePath"

        if ((!(Test-Path $targetPath)) -and (Test-Path $backupPath)) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored deleted file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Restore-Tab4QProcessRuntimeRunnerScriptRepairPatch {
    param(
        [string]$ProjectRoot,
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [object]$Manifest
    )

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE STARTED"

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.overwritten_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath
        $backupPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $backupPath) {
            $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent
            if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            Copy-Item -Path $backupPath -Destination $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Restored overwritten file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    foreach ($item in $Manifest.newly_created_files) {
        $relativePath = [string]$item
        $targetPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $relativePath

        if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
            Remove-Item -Path $targetPath -Force
            Write-Host "Removed newly created file: $targetPath"
        }
    }

    Write-Host "SURGICAL RESTORE COMPLETED"
}

try {
    if (!(Test-Path $PROJECT_ROOT)) {
        throw "Project root not found: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $ZIP_PATH)) {
        throw "Patch ZIP not found: $ZIP_PATH"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path $TARGET_PATH)) {
        throw "Target file not found: $TARGET_RELATIVE"
    }

    if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_runtime_collector\runtime_runner.py"))) {
        throw "Canonical runtime runner not found."
    }

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT ".project_reference")) {
        Write-Host "Preserving .project_reference exactly as requested."
    }

    if (Test-Path $TEMP_DIR) {
        Remove-Item -Path $TEMP_DIR -Recurse -Force
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TEMP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BACKUP_DIR -Force | Out-Null
    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $rewrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    $backupTargetPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $TARGET_RELATIVE
    $backupTargetParent = Split-Path $backupTargetPath -Parent
    if (!(Test-Path $backupTargetParent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupTargetParent -Force | Out-Null
    }
    Copy-Item -Path $TARGET_PATH -Destination $backupTargetPath -Force
    $overwrittenFiles.Add($TARGET_RELATIVE)

    $source = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($TARGET_PATH)

    $oldLine = '    process_args = [str(_RUNTIME_RUNNER_SCRIPT.resolve())]'
    $newBlock = @'
    runtime_runner_script = (
        _tab4_tool_root()
        / CANONICAL_PACKAGE_NAME
        / "reasoner_runtime_collector"
        / "runtime_runner.py"
    ).resolve()
    process_args = [str(runtime_runner_script)]
'@

    if ($source.Contains($oldLine)) {
        $source = $source.Replace($oldLine, $newBlock.TrimEnd())
        Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $TARGET_PATH -Text $source
        $rewrittenFiles.Add($TARGET_RELATIVE)
        Write-Host "Patched Tab 4 QProcess runtime runner path."
    }
    elseif ($source.Contains("process_args = [str(runtime_runner_script)]")) {
        Write-Host "Tab 4 QProcess runtime runner path already patched."
    }
    else {
        throw "Could not find expected stale process_args line."
    }

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/") -notlike "patch_metadata\*"
        }

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $existsBefore = Test-Path $targetPath

        $copiedFiles.Add($relativePath)

        if ($existsBefore) {
            $overwrittenFiles.Add($relativePath)

            $backupPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $relativePath
            $backupParent = Split-Path $backupPath -Parent

            if (!(Test-Path $backupParent)) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupParent -Force | Out-Null
            }

            if (!(Test-Path $backupPath)) {
                Copy-Item -Path $targetPath -Destination $backupPath -Force
            }
        }

        if (!$existsBefore) {
            $newlyCreatedFiles.Add($relativePath)
        }
    }

    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        patch_name = $PATCH_NAME
        timestamp = $STAMP
        project_root = $PROJECT_ROOT
        zip_path = $ZIP_PATH
        backup_dir = $BACKUP_DIR
        copied_files = @($copiedFiles)
        overwritten_files = @($overwrittenFiles)
        newly_created_files = @($newlyCreatedFiles)
        rewritten_files = @($rewrittenFiles)
        deleted_files = @()
        deleted_dirs = @()
        preserved_paths = @(".project_reference")
        repair_reason = "Force Tab 4 QProcess runtime trace launcher to use canonical reasoner_runtime_collector runtime_runner.py."
        canonical_runtime_runner = "kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_runtime_collector\runtime_runner.py"
        skipped_zip_metadata = @("patch_metadata")
    }

    $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Encoding UTF8

    foreach ($file in $patchFiles) {
        $relativePath = $file.FullName.Substring($TEMP_DIR.Length).TrimStart("\", "/")
        $targetPath = Join-Path $PROJECT_ROOT $relativePath
        $targetParent = Split-Path $targetPath -Parent

        if (!(Test-Path $targetParent)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
        }

        Copy-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $targetPath -Force
        Write-Host "Copied patch file: $relativePath"
    }

    python -m py_compile `
        kanda_reasoner_app\reasoner_tools_shell\runner_help\window_process_private_impl.py `
        tests\test_tab4_qprocess_runtime_runner_script_repair.py

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "py_compile failed for Tab 4 QProcess runtime runner path repair."
    }

    python -m unittest tests.test_tab4_qprocess_runtime_runner_script_repair -v

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Tab 4 QProcess runtime runner path repair focused test failed."
    }

    Write-Host "PATCH INSTALLED"
    Write-Host "Manifest: $MANIFEST_PATH"
    Write-Host "Backup: $BACKUP_DIR"

    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Clear-Host
}
catch {
    Write-Host "INSTALL FAILED"
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message

    if (Test-Path $MANIFEST_PATH) {
        $manifestForRestore = Get-Content -Path $MANIFEST_PATH -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        Restore-Tab4QProcessRuntimeRunnerScriptRepairPatch -ProjectRoot $PROJECT_ROOT -BackupDir $BACKUP_DIR -Manifest $manifestForRestore
    }

    exit 1
}

    param(
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$Text
    )

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($TargetPath, $Text, $utf8NoBom)
}

try {

    Expand-Archive -Path $ZIP_PATH -DestinationPath $TEMP_DIR -Force

    $copiedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $overwrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $newlyCreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $rewrittenFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    $backupTargetPath = Join-Path $BACKUP_DIR $TARGET_RELATIVE
    $backupTargetParent = Split-Path $backupTargetPath -Parent

    }
    Copy-Item -Path $TARGET_PATH -Destination $backupTargetPath -Force
    $overwrittenFiles.Add($TARGET_RELATIVE)

    $source = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($TARGET_PATH)

    $oldEnvLine = "    tool_root = _tab4_tool_root()"
    $newEnvLine = "    tool_root = project_root if _has_reasoner_package(project_root) else _tab4_tool_root()"

    if ($source.Contains($oldEnvLine)) {

    }
    elseif ($source.Contains($newEnvLine)) {
        Write-Host "Child PYTHONPATH root already prefers selected project root."
    }
    else {

    }

    $oldCollectorLine = '        str(_installed_package_dir(_tab4_tool_root()) / "reasoner_tools_shell" / "runner.py"),'

    )

    Write-Utf8NoBom -TargetPath $TARGET_PATH -Text $source
    $rewrittenFiles.Add($TARGET_RELATIVE)

    $patchFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $TEMP_DIR -File -Recurse |
        Where-Object {

        }

            }
